purpose: Resolve the provider Python version without spending another H200 or reading any model or dataset.

observed_python.evidence: The managed-run environment creation line precedes the provider project-install failure.

managed_run.reason: The provider attempted an editable project install even though the isolated probe directory intentionally had no pyproject.toml or setup.py.

decision: Bind the next preregistration to the Axolotl template and explicitly validate the provider-created active root .venv while keeping it outside the scientific content tree.
